news.title: US states sue SpaceX over Grok AI’s creation of child sexual abuse material
news.summary: Virginia and Oregon filed separate lawsuits on Monday, accusing the company of promoting Grok's 'spicy mode'.

news.title: UK sanctions top Myanmar military leaders after Rohingya genocide ruling
news.summary: The UK is joined by several other nations in recognising an ICJ ruling that Myanmar carried out genocide.

news.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
news.summary: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.

news.title: Os sinais de que a guerra na Ucrânia está se expandindo no mundo
news.summary: Ucrânia reivindicou ataque a navios russos na Líbia. Incidente é episódio mais recente de uma série de ocorrências que reforçam o temor de uma ampliação geográfica do conflito além das linhas de combate no leste europeu.

news.title: CVM suspende registro do BRB, envolvido no caso Master
news.summary: Autarquia puniu empresas que deixaram de divulgar informações obrigatórias ao mercado por mais de um ano. Banco de Brasília enfrenta investigações sobre operações com grupo de Daniel Vorcaro.

news.title: Em busca do 3º mandato, Bukele projeta influência na América Latina
news.summary: Com forte apoio popular, líder salvadorenho concorrerá novamente após uma controversa reforma constitucional. Medidas adotadas em El Salvador servem de referência para governos de direita e embasam atuação no Haiti.

news.title: Estudo brasileiro aponta alta eficácia da bactéria Wolbachia contra dengue
news.summary: Pesquisa em Belo Horizonte reforça o potencial da Wolbachia, bactéria que reduz a capacidade do Aedes aegypti de transmitir vírus. Análise reuniu cientistas brasileiros e de universidades dos EUA.

news.title: La OTAN autoriza el despliegue de un avión AWACS tras el incidente con un presunto proyectil ruso en Polonia
news.summary: El jefe militar operativo de la OTAN ha ordenado el despliegue de un avión de vigilancia AWACS para vigilar el espacio aéreo europeo tras la incursión de un misil J-101 atribuido a Rusia en espacio aéreo polaco la semana pasada.

news.title: Ucrania reivindica nuevos ataques a más de 1.500 kilómetros del frente sobre posiciones petrolíferas rusas
news.summary: El Estado Mayor de las Fuerzas Armadas de Ucrania ha reivindicado este lunes nuevos ataques a más de 1.500 kilómetros de la frontera sobre posiciones petroleras rusas en las localidades de Perm y Tartaristán.

news.title: Libya's east seeks UN probe into claims Ukrainian military present in west
news.summary: Authorities in divided Libya's east called on Monday for the United Nations to investigate claims that Ukrainian forces were present in the country's west, as they lodged a complaint over Ukrainian attacks on two Russian ships off Benghazi. The strikes on Sunday, claimed by Kyiv, come as Ukraine steps up strikes against Russia far from the front lines of their war. FRANCE 24's Emerald Maxwell reports.

news.title: Trump backs Nvidia boss's return but top Democrat vows probe
news.summary: US President Donald Trump praised Nvidia's decision Monday to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive, as top Senate Democrat Chuck Schumer vowed to investigate potential wrongdoing amid mounting national security concerns. Trump also posted a doctored version of the famous photograph of him raising his fist after surviving a 2024 assassination attempt, replacing himself with Huang, who brandished a red bra beneath an Nvidia flag. FRANCE 24's Fraser Jackson reports from Washington.

news.title: How far will Ukraine war spread? Kyiv targets Russian vessels in Libya
news.summary: Talk about spillover. In the Libyan port of Benghazi, Ukraine claiming responsibility for the sinkings first of a Russian warship and then a cargo vessel. That’s on top of the sanctioned ship struck in the Baltic Sea that’s since strayed into Finland’s waters. Legitimate targets?

news.title: Ukraine claims it sank Russian warship off Libya
news.summary: Ukraine on Monday claimed it was behind strikes on two Russian vessels off Libya, including one that sank a modern warship, in the latest spillover from Moscow's invasion. The attacks on Sunday near the Libyan port of Benghazi come at a time when Ukraine has stepped up its daring strikes against Russia far from the frontlines in retaliation for Moscow's deadly invasion. FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg reports from Kyiv.

news.title: Nvidia reinstates Huang as CEO after Trump intervention
news.summary: Nvidia on Monday reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive in a stunning reversal that President Donald Trump said followed his own direct contacts with the company's board. Huang resigned two weeks ago over an affair with a woman whom US intelligence agencies suspect of spying for China, a departure that sent Wall Street tumbling and stoked fears for a US economy reliant on the AI investment boom. FRANCE 24's Carys Garland and Wassim Cornet report.

news.title: Irán ve absurdo que EEUU intente imponer un bloqueo terrestre como medida de presión
news.summary: El ministro de Exteriores iraní, Abbas Araqchi, ha considerado que los planes de Estados Unidos para imponer algún tipo de bloqueo terrestre al país son simplemente absurdos por consideraciones geográficas y por las relaciones diplomáticas que preserva la República Islámica.

news.title: 'Maintain control': UN chief calls for creation of global AI safety framework within a year
news.summary: UN chief Antonio Guterres on Monday urged countries to agree on the creation of a global framework for managing the dangers posed by artificial intelligence within one year. Speaking at a summit in Barbados, he warned that taming the technology is vital if humanity is to stay in charge of its own future.

news.title: Ainda é possível evitar a catástrofe climática?
news.summary: De recordes de calor a inundações devastadoras e incêndios florestais, os sinais de alerta estão por toda parte. Ainda é possível controlar o aumento das temperaturas?

news.title: 'Queremos destruir o capitalismo': por dentro das manifestações dos 'black blocks' da esquerda radical na França
news.summary: A BBC ouviu os manifestantes de extrema-esquerda acusados pelo presidente francês Emmanuel Macron de tentar derrubar a República.

news.title: Merz condena "provocações" da Rússia após queda de mísseis na Polônia
news.summary: Chefe do governo alemão reagiu ao episódio envolvendo três projéteis russos que atingiram o país vizinho e reafirmou o compromisso de defesa coletiva da aliança militar.

news.title: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
news.summary: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.

news.title: U.S. to co-host 2031 Women's World Cup with Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica
news.summary: The UK, led by England, will host the 2035 edition.

news.title: 'Deeply shocked': Gisèle Pelicot to sue publisher after nude photos used in book campaign
news.summary: French feminist icon Gisèle Pelicot, who became a worldwide symbol against sexual violence during the 2024 rape trials against her husband and dozens of other men, said Monday she will take legal action after nude images of her were sent out without her permission to publicise a psychoanalyst's book on coercive control.

news.title: O mais famoso problema da Matemática que funcionário da Anthropic diz ter solucionado com ajuda da IA
news.summary: Matemático da empresa Anthropic afirma ter usado IA para comprovar a famosa hipótese de Riemann. A verificação da sua resposta, no entanto, deve levar tempo.

news.title: The collapse of UN climate talks over fossil fuels was years in the making
news.summary: While negotiations collapsed over one main point of contention — whether to include language about fossil fuels, the main driver of global warming — this fight over this has been building for many years.

news.title: Como a Alemanha quer salvar sua previdência iniciando a contribuição aos 6 anos
news.summary: País quer incentivar poupança para aposentadoria desde a infância através de subsídio mensal em conta de investimentos. Mas analistas advertem que medida não resolverá o desafio do financiamento da previdência alemã.

news.title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world
news.summary: Interests of oil-producing countries, a US boycott and a dispute over finance may have torpedoed climate talks.

news.title: Comedian impersonates Trump's dance moves, mocks trade talks at Canada press dinner
news.summary: The impersonator, Canadian comedian Mark Critch, poked fun at the US president's search for a new press secretary and US-Canada trade talks.

news.title: Após ser rejeitada pelo Borussia Dortmund, Rheinmetall leva patrocínio para esportes de inverno
news.summary: Fabricante de armamentos firmou acordo até os Jogos de Inverno de 2030 com federação alemã de bobsled, luge e skeleton. Além de recursos financeiros, parceria prevê cooperação tecnológica.

news.title: Israeli attacks have turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland', Oxfam says
news.summary: The report says there are signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza as a result of Israel's actions.

news.title: "A Ronda Noturna" de Rembrandt: mais viva do que se poderia imaginar
news.summary: Novo projeto artístico e exposição revela o mundo oculto de micróbios que cobre uma das pinturas mais famosas do artista barroco holandês.

news.title: Finland summons Russian ambassador after suspected airspace violation
news.summary: Finland on Monday said it had summoned Russia's ambassador over a suspected violation of Finnish airspace by a Russian helicopter and after a Ukrainian drone strike on a Russian cargo ship located in the Gulf of Finland in recent days. Helsinki also condemned Moscow's escalating strikes on civilian targets in Ukraine.

news.title: Eisenkot modera su postura sobre Irán y no ve a Teherán como una amenaza inmediata para Israel
news.summary: El líder opositor israelí y encargado de formar Gobierno, Gadi Eisenkot, no tiene entre sus prioridades, si consigue convertirse en primer ministro, un reinicio de la campaña militar contra Irán porque la República Islámica no representa a su entender la amenaza inmediata y existencial de la que lleva años alertando el todavía jefe del Gobierno y gran rival político, Benjamin Netanyahu.

news.title: Ofensiva israelense transformou Gaza em "deserto tóxico", diz ONG britânica
news.summary: Contaminação ambiental em Gaza pode afetar saúde da população por décadas, alerta novo relatório da Oxfam. Estudo aponta sinais de poluição em mais de 99% do território após anos de conflito.

news.title: What Trump told PBS News about Jensen Huang before Nvidia reinstatement
news.summary: In a phone call with PBS News shortly after 8 a.m. EST Monday, Trump did not deny that he had been briefed, saying he was "not going to comment on anything having to do with that. You'll have to figure that out for yourself."

news.title: Rutte reitera que no hay consenso para la adhesión de Ucrania mientras Zelenski pide que aclare las garantías
news.summary: El secretario general de la OTAN, Mark Rutte, ha reiterado este lunes que Ucrania tiene la perspectiva de ingresar en la Alianza Atlántica pero no hay consenso sobre la adhesión, mientras que el presidente ucraniano, Volodimir Zelenski, ha reclamado que la organización aclare el tipo de garantías de seguridad ofrecerá a Kiev para el escenario posguerra, después de que se haya instalado la idea de que serán similar a la clausula de defensa mutua de la OTAN.

news.title: After Japan's APEC snub, what's next for its China ties?
news.summary: Japan has long-running concerns over Chinese military expansionism, and Beijing has bristled at Sanae Takaichi's comments on Taiwan. The frosty ties were on full display at the APEC summit.

news.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drones in Libya, Zelensky says
news.summary: The Kremlin warns of an "escalation of tensions in the region", but declines to comment directly on the attacks in Libya.

news.title: Centenas de escolas recebem ameaças de bomba na Alemanha e Dinamarca
news.summary: Autoridades descartaram risco concreto após o envio massivo de mensagens que alertavam sobre supostos explosivos. Investigações buscam identificar os responsáveis.

news.title: More than 12,000 fans were evacuated from Don Toliver concert after an unknown substance sickens fans
news.summary: One person was hospitalized, and more than 50 were assessed for eye and respiratory symptoms.

news.title: A reviravolta que fez Jensen Huang voltar ao comando da Nvidia após escândalo de traição e espionagem
news.summary: O conselho votou de forma unânime pela recondução de Jensen Huang ao cargo, segundo um comunicado divulgado no site da Nvidia nesta segunda-feira.
